title: This Simple AI Setup Makes Me $8K Every Month
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: Video is built around OpenArt (Arena leaderboard, Seedance model) with a free doc link; sponsorship not stated but likely

stated_problem.quote: Nobody has a Spanish version, even though one in seven people speak Spanish at home.
stated_problem.speaker: Chris Koerner

idea.name: AI lip-synced Spanish dubbing for local business videos
idea.one_liner: Use the top lip-sync model on OpenArt to dub local businesses' ads and videos into Spanish, offering a free first video by DM then two a month for $500
idea.customer: home services, dentists/med spas, real estate agents, farmers market vendors, food trucks
idea.offer: lip-synced Spanish versions of existing videos

key_quotes.quote: And you can fix that for them for a fee in about 20 minutes and charge 300 bucks per video to do it.
I made a Spanish version of one of your videos for free. No catch.
If it brings in customers, I can do two a month for $500.

claims.quote: Get 10 clients, and you're at six grand a month for something that takes you an afternoon.

claims.claim: His single test DM got no response
claims.quote: Sadly, maybe not a surprise to most of you, I did not get a response to that DM.

acquisition_channels.details: DM/text vendors with a free pre-made Spanish version
cold texts and LinkedIn messages at volume

ideas.delivery: upload video to OpenArt Seedance 2.5 with a one-line dubbing prompt; 1-2 minute generation

uk_legal_risk.reason: Cold texts/DMs to sole-trader vendors fall under PECR consent rules

ideas.other_uk_rules: Voice/likeness cloning needs the subject's consent; ad content must stay accurate under CAP Code

idea.name: Dub your own YouTube channel into multiple languages
idea.one_liner: Add AI-dubbed audio tracks in 13 languages to earn ad revenue from foreign views
idea.revenue_model: YouTube ad revenue at ~$8 RPM on foreign views

key_quotes.quote: And I make about on my foreign views, I make like $8 per thousand views.
So, that's $8,000 extra dollars a month that I would not have gotten otherwise.

claims.claim: Over a million foreign views per month since dubbing started April 2026
claims.quote: So, I'm getting over a million views per month.

idea.name: Dubbing service for YouTubers with 100K+ subscribers
idea.one_liner: Sell creators extra-language audio tracks to open Mexico, Spain, Colombia on existing videos

key_quotes.quote: So, one dubbed track can open up Mexico, Spain, Colombia, Costa Rica on a video that they've already put time and money into.
